items.synopsis: IPsec VPN is getting flapped due to warning messages on MIST controlled devices
items.description: On all Junos SRX, vSRX and NFX platforms , commit after deprecated configuration of APPQOE (Application Quality of Experience ) is pushed, will trigger DAX warning on the console which causes iked/kmd process to flap of IPsec VPN ( Internet Protocol Security Virtual Private Network ) and results into traffic outage.

items.synopsis: The process bbe-smgd crash will be observed in the Subscriber login/logout scenario
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, in a scaled stack-based Subscriber Management scenario (e.g PPPOE, DHCP, PS over LT interface, etc.), the bbe-smgd process crash will be observed with continuous login/logout of a large number of subscribers over a period.

items.synopsis: Increase in task memory observed on 'clear validation database'
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, when routing-options session validation is configured, and BGP is configured, task memory usage increases in every iteration on executing 'clear validation database' command.

items.category: Track PRs in BGP BMP area & is part of BGP inside RPD.
items.synopsis: The EOR message is missed for one peer in a scaled BMP scenario
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms with BGP Monitoring Protocol (BMP) enabled in scaled scenario (4K BGP peers, 6 BMP stations), after disabling/enabling BMP, due to timing issues, one out of six BMP stations will not receive End-of-RIB (EOR) message for one peer. This will not impact routing or data forwarding, however will have impact on data collection.

items.category: Track PRs in BGP BMP area & is part of BGP inside RPD.
items.synopsis: Routes getting stuck in hidden state forever in BMP scenario
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms where BMP (BGP Monitoring Protocol) is configured, the routes are not removed from the RIB (Routing Information Base) even when the damping timer expires and they are stuck in the hidden

items.synopsis: MX304 not reachable with the power-off failure on the PIC
items.description: When an MX304 LMIC is offline due to a power issue, it may take up to 20 minutes for the LMIC to come back online. You can configure event-options to reduce the time to restart the LMIC. See also: TSB83899

items.synopsis: Reachability issue observed when trying to ping oversize packet via IRB
items.description: Reachability issue observed when trying to ping oversize packet via IRB

items.synopsis: Traffic drop is seen when "monitor traffic interface" command is issued for an interface on Junos SRX platforms
items.description: On Junos SRX4100/SRX4200 platform, starting and stopping the "monitor traffic interface", causes the VPN tunnel or tagged traffic to be dropped. However, keeping the "monitor traffic interface" running, ensures that traffic will function properly. Issue occurs when monitor interface command on an interface is performed on devices that has vlan-tagging configured.

items.synopsis: High CPU utilisation by the nsd process observed due to DNS common cache and multiple update handlers
items.description: On Junos SRX platforms, due to common cache feature, more accurate IP address resolutions are being updated to the PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine). However, this led to increased CPU utilisation by the nsd (Network Services Daemon) process. Due to high CPU load, the newly resolved IP addresses may not be updated promptly to PFE leading to traffic loss.

items.category: idp flow creation, deletion, notification, session mgr intfce
items.synopsis: Memory leak will be observed on all SRX platforms when IDP is configured
items.description: On SRX platforms with IDP (Intrusion Detection and Prevention ) enabled, while processing IDP traffic a memory leak can occur which would lead to regular flow processing being affected as memory depletes eventually. This issue affects the following Junos releases: 21.2R3-S8, 21.4R3-S7/8, 22.2R3-S3/4, 22.3R3-S3, 22.4R3-S2/3, 23.2R2, 23.2R2-S1 and 24.2R1. All other releases are not affected by this issue.

items.synopsis: RPD crash due to BGP sharding and SRv6
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, when Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) rib-sharding is enabled and segment routing v6 is configured, the routing protocol process (rpd) crashes.

items.synopsis: jdhcpd core dumps may be seen on ALQ setups when subscriber synchronization is done
items.description: DHCP ALQ (Active Leasequery) Sessions go down due to core dumps in jdhcpd (Juniper DHCP Daemon). These jdhcpd core dumps may be seen on ALQ setups when subscriber synchronization happens after the TCP (Transmission Control Protocol) connection comes up.

items.synopsis: JUNOS_REG:EX4650-48Y:ZTPv6:Failed to reconnect to device as unable to load configuration to device via shelscript from ztp server
items.description: During ZTP, if shell script is used (for config download), it will not work on EX46 platforms However, if the baseline config is downloaded via regular way (as config file and not shell script), it will work.

items.synopsis: Traffic loss for VPN going down due to inconsistency between the VPN configuration in the iked and the service-redundancy-group database
items.description: On certain SRX platforms using iked (Internet Key Exchange Protocol Daemon) with IPsec (Internet Protocol Security) and MNHA (Multi-Node High Availability) configured, traffic loss can occur when the VPN (Virtual Private Network) service-redundancy-group becomes active and there is an inconsistency between the VPN configuration in the iked and the service-redundancy-group database. This issue arises if the reconciliation process takes over 5 minutes and the VPN service-redundancy-group switches to backup before completing the reconciliation, especially with a high number of VPN tunnels (up to 16, 000) and VPN IKE traceoptions set to the highest level.

items.synopsis: JUNOS and JUNOS EVO-RPD process crash under High Availability Route Engine (RE) scenarios when L2circuits are enabled
items.description: Routing Protocol Daemon (RPD) process crash when l2circuits are enabled in scenarios with backup Route Engine (RE).

items.synopsis: Persistent MAC getting stuck in the SRP state results in traffic loss in the EVPN-VxLAN scenario
items.description: On Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, traffic loss is observed when the Persistent MAC gets stuck in the SRP (Static, Remote, Pinned) state and not removed during the "clear persistence mac' operation for some MACs that are getting added with an incorrect flag: SRP. The issue happens when MAC learning happens on Multihoming peers where 'persistent-learning' is enabled in an EVPN-VxLAN (Ethernet VPN-Virtual Extensible LAN) environment. MAC is just marked as Persistent but not installed in the Persistent database.

items.synopsis: MAC addresses learnt on interfaces part of VLAN with MAC limiting by interface and "drop-and-log" action configured are cleared after VLAN description is changed
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, when "set vlans switch-options interface-mac-limit packet-action drop-and-log" is configured, changing the Virtual Local Area Network (VLAN) description will cause flush of Media Access Control (MAC) addresses learnt on the interfaces part of the VLAN and traffic impact

items.category: Issues related to Junos licensing infrastructure
items.synopsis: License is lost on NG-RE platforms after device/routing-engine reboot
items.description: On NG-RE (Next Generation Routing Engine) platforms, license is lost after restarting device/routing-engine. If any service depends on that license, that service will be impacted.

items.synopsis: Premature graceful RE switchover causes traffic blackhole during software upgrade on PTX platforms with dual RE
items.description: This issue affects PE-based (Provider Edge) PTX platforms running Junos. During a software upgrade involving dual Routing Engine (RE) systems, if Graceful Routing Engine Switchover (GRES) is performed prematurely, it can lead to a traffic blackhole.

items.synopsis: Restricted Proxy ARP feature does not work as expected
items.description: On all Junos QFX5K and EX4K platforms supporting restricted 'proxy-arp' feature, when restricted 'proxy-arp' is enabled on IRB (Integrated Routing and Bridging) interface, hosts within the same subnet will not be able to reach each other.

items.synopsis: On Junos QFX5K, EX4100, EX4300, EX4400 and EX4650, Type 5 tunnel traffic loss observed when all IRB interfaces are deleted
items.description: On all Junos QFX5K, EX4100, EX4300, EX4400 and EX4650 platforms with EVPN-VxLAN (Ethernet Virtual Private Network-Virtual Extensible LAN), deleting the all IRB (Integrated Routing and Bridging) interfaces while still having Type 5 tunnels installed results in Type 5 tunnel traffic loss when Type 5 tunnel MAC (Media Access Control ) is same as global/chassis IRB MAC.

items.synopsis: The rpd process can crash during a race condition when BGP rib-sharding is configured
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, when BGP RIB sharding is configured, the rpd process crashes during a rare race condition where multiple threads try to initialise a single global variable. During the rpd crash and restart, all routing protocols will be impacted and traffic disruption will be seen due to the loss of routing information.

items.synopsis: Detour path is not coming up when detour hop-limit is set to 255 or high value
items.description: detour might not form when hop-limit is set to be high value

items.synopsis: Traffic blackholing observed due to PFE remaining active despite CM_CMERROR_FABRIC_SELFPING errors
items.description: On MX2008, MX2010, MX2020 and MX10K platforms with MPC1-9 line cards, the PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) remains active despite CM_CMERROR_FABRIC_SELFPING errors which leads to a traffic blackholing to that PFE.

items.category: Generic platform and infra issues for MS-MIC and MS-MPC(XLP)
items.synopsis: mspmand crash on clear/show services sessions" parallel in high scale on MX platforms
items.description: On Junos MX with MS-MPC/MS-MIC cards, when clear service sessions are executed from multiple windows (approx 5 terminals), the PIC reboots and eventually all the service traffic will be impacted.

items.category: Track usability related J-Web PR, like UI layout, workflow
items.synopsis: Unable to Define NAT Policy Address Names Containing Dots or Slashes in J-Web
items.description: On all SRX series platforms enabled with J-Web, NAT (Network Address Translation) policies cannot be edited/added using J-Web if the destination address name contains '.' dot or '/' slash.

items.synopsis: The ~root/.ssh directory contents is deleted on every reboot
items.description: On all SRX platforms the contents of ~root/.ssh directory is deleted on every reboot. This can cause issues with SSH issues as locally stored public and private keys are deleted (stored on ~root/.ssh by default)

items.category: Issues related to broadband edge apps (PPP, DHCP) on Trio ch
items.synopsis: Traffic drop due to mac-validate failure on MX platforms
items.description: On Junos MX platforms, when subscriber management is enabled and mac-validate is configured on interfaces, traffic drop is seen while attempting to add a new link to an existing AE (Aggregate Ethernet) bundle from a different FPC.

items.synopsis: Traffic loss is observed along with error messages on Junos MX platforms with MPC1 to MPC9, LC2101, LC480 (including MX204, MX10003) during any transport LSP change operation
items.description: On Junos MX platforms with MPC1 to MPC9, LC2101, LC480 (including MX204, MX10003) having linecards with more than one PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) instance in FPC (Flexible PIC Concentrators) and "chained-composite-next-hop" knob OR "preserve-nexthop-hierarchy" knob OR SR-MPLS (Segment Routing - Multiprotocol Label Switching ) OR EVPN (Ethernet Virtual Private Network) over MPLS configuration, traffic loss will be seen due to any transport LSP (Label-switched Path) change operation including interface flaps.

items.synopsis: XQSS_CMERROR errors will be seen which might disable PFE
items.description: On MX204, MX10003 and MX platforms with MPC7, MPC8, MPC9, LC480, LC2101, LC2103, MPC10 and MPC11 line cards or EX92xx platforms with EX9200-40XS, EX9200-12QS, EX9253-6Q12C, EX9253-6Q12C-M line cards, SRX5400, SRX5600, SRX5800 platforms with SRX5K-IOC4-10G, SRX5K-IOC4-MRAT line cards, in a scenario where there could be fabric drops because of over-subscription or CRC errors, there could be case when the same tail entry get re-used across packets leading to packet corruption and CM error. This is a corner case and might lead to PFE(Packet Forwarding Engine) disable resulting in traffic loss.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: Enrollment attempt from non-root user fails with "[Error] Get CA certificates failed"
items.description: When attempting enrollment of a device onto ATP Cloud with non-root user after previously enrolling and disenrolling with root user, the enrollment may fail with "[Error] Get CA certificates failed".

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: The system scripts refresh will fail when using load CLI option
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms when the 'edit system scripts' hierarchy configuration is changed using loading a configuration from a file or the terminal using 'load' option, the scripts refresh will fail.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: The mgd process crashes while using an FQDN in conjunction with the ephemeral configuration database
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, the mgd process crashes when device has an ephemeral configuration database instance and an FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) is used for NTP (Network Time Protocol), radius-server, tacplus-server, etc. in either the main static configuration or the ephemeral configuration database.

items.synopsis: After RE switchover the VRRP master and backup router will start functioning as master routers
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved MX platforms configured with VRRP (Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol) and NSR (Non-Stop Routing), after RE switchover or GRES (Graceful Routing Engine Switchover) the master router would starts sending VRRP advertisements with a different priority value. As a result, both the master and backup VRRP routers will begin operating as the master which results in inconsistent traffic routing or packet loss as the system fails to establish a single master node.

items.synopsis: NSD validation failure results into upgrade failure for Junos MX platforms
items.description: On Junos MX240, MX480, MX960 platforms, the Network Security Daemon (nsd) validation fails during upgrades.

items.synopsis: Multiple error logs will be seen on all the FPCs
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved ULC-based platforms, after the software upgrade multiple non-service impacting error logs will be seen on the Flexible PIC Concentrator (FPC).

items.synopsis: Node0 40G interfaces on Junos SRX5K platforms go down after failover
items.description: On Junos SRX5400/5600/5800 platforms in cluster, with 40G interface in layer 2 (L2) transparent mode, when the chassis failovers, the interfaces on node0 will remain in a down state and will not come up.

items.synopsis: RPD process crash is seen on high scale peering scenario where the sessions are un-configured/shutdown abruptly
items.description: The RPD process crashes on all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms in a highly scaled scenario of more than 2000 BGP peers if the BGP sessions are un-configured/brought down abruptly. This leads to loss of routing information and will lead to loss of protocol traffic.

items.synopsis: ACX5448: Noticing "Host 0 RTC Battery failure" alarm after few hours of power cycling the chassis
items.description: False RTC Battery failure alarm reported on ACX5448 Major Host 0 RTC Battery failure.

items.synopsis: Timingd stuck on master RE
items.description: On Junos MX platforms, timingd might become stucked on master RE; however, when master RE is switched to backup RE, this issue is not seen.

items.synopsis: 22.4R3-S4: JWEB : While creating services, application protocols are not listed under services for destination zone security policy.
items.description: 22.4R3-S4: JWEB : While creating services, application protocols are not listed under services for destination zone security policy.

items.synopsis: Aggregated ethernet interface flaps can be seen when IRB interface is activated or deactivated
items.description: On all Junos and Junos evolved platforms configured with AE (Aggregated Ethernet) interface and esi "auto-derive type-3-system-mac" knob configured, if an IRB (Integrated Routing and Bridging) interface is activated or deactivated the link aggregation interfaces ( IFL) will get flapped due to which interface traffic gets impacted.

items.synopsis: The traffic is getting duplicated when VPLS to EVPN transition is performed
items.description: On Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms with MPC10, MPC11, LC9600 and MX304-LMIC line cards, during a transition from VPLS (Virtual Private LAN Services) to EVPN (Ethernet Virtual Private Network) or when the MAC (Media Access Control Address) addresses move from a local to a remote state, control MAC addresses are incorrectly programmed in the hardware, leading to traffic duplication and unresolved destination errors.

items.category: Issues related to Junos licensing infrastructure
items.synopsis: BGP sessions flap due to license updates
items.description: On all Junos platforms, a BGP flap is observed when a license key is upgraded or a new license is added resulting in traffic loss.

items.synopsis: QFX5k : The pps rate for egress interface becomes zero after removing one of VCP ports
items.description: On QFX5k virtual-chassis platforms working with 5e image, the pps rate display output for the egress interface would become zero after removing one of the VCP ports. The traffic is received as expected and it is only not displayed in the output.

items.synopsis: IPv6 NS packets not forwarded to access port due to VXLAN snoop entry
items.description: On Junos QFX5120 platforms, when MLD (Multicast Listener Discovery) snooping is enabled, IPv6 NS (Neighbor Solicitation) packets received on the network port are not forwarded to the access port. This issue is caused by a VXLAN (Virtual Extensible Local-Area Network) configuration that incorrectly redirects these packets back to the network port using an RedirectIPMC action. As a result, IPv6 ND (Neighbor Discovery) fails to complete, leading to IPv6 pings not working on the network port and disrupting IPv6 traffic.

items.synopsis: JDI_REG:: QFX5200:: After ISSU upgrade, device is hanged and not able to perform any operations until USB recovery done on device
items.description: When TISSU upgrade is done from 22.4 release onwards, the box come up as backup RE.

items.synopsis: srpfe core during SAV longevity testing
items.description: when SAV enabled, there is a corner case when pfe memory is not enough, coredump might happen inside rtcom http proxy module due to a race condition.

items.synopsis: The cl interface goes down when the dl interface is disabled for link failover
items.description: On the SRX300 series platforms and SRX550 supporting the LTE Mini-Physical Interface Module (Mini-PIM), the cellular interface (cl) goes down when the dialer interface (dl) interface is disabled for link failover.

items.synopsis: Monitored-Status keeps Up after CTL link down in branch model SRX HA
items.description: After CTL link down, Monitored-Status in "show chassis cluster interfaces" keeps showing "Up" state.

items.category: Issues related to broadband edge apps (PPP, DHCP) on ZT/YT
items.synopsis: [MX960] An explanation of the following messages VBFMAN:SEND_CLIENT: PacketL2Inject Failed. error:Invalid argument and VBFMAN:PFE_EVENT_BULKING: Sending of PFE event bulked message to SMGD Failed len:0
items.description: Vbfman bulks event notification before sending them to smgd. If buffer is not yet full then it starts a timer, to bulk the events. But an another event comes before timer expires and it fills buffer the it sendout notification in that context itself. As a result when timer expires it doesn't have any more buffer to sendout. These were harmless error messages now it will be logged as debug message.

items.synopsis: Configuration push to device using RPC resulted in incorrect policy order
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, RPC command with default-operation replace uses load update instead of load override from Junos 21.1 onwards. Policies could get incorrectly reordered impacting traffic, because load update does not honor the replace: tag present in configuration file loaded.

items.synopsis: PFE goes to disabled state with multicast multi-threaded traffic with video monitoring configuration
items.description: On all Junos MX platforms with MPC2, MPC3, MPC4, MPC5 and MPC6 line cards and video monitoring configuration enabled, the Packet Forwarding Engine(PFE) goes in to disabled state when multicast traffic with more than 10 downstream interfaces. This leads to traffic loss.

items.synopsis: vSRX 3.0 with Junos release below 24.2R1 on KVM not booting up correctly in recent Linux Distributions
items.description: Starting in QEMU 8.1, SMBIOSv3 is enabled by default with a 64-bit entrypoint. Junos OS versions below 24.2R1 only support 32-bit SMBIOS entrypoints, so they will fail to boot on systems using KVM alongside QEMU versions at or above 8.1.
